title: PlayerMotionBatch
description: Batch of raw linear acceleration samples sent from a player device during an active NOTA session. Scoring and smoothing are computed server-side.

playerId.description: Stable player identifier (UUID v4), persisted on the device.

playerName.description: Display name for the player on leaderboards and dashboards.

batchStartedAt.description: Milliseconds since epoch when this batch window started. Use to detect stale updates and align with RuntimeGameState snapshots.

batchEndedAt.description: Milliseconds since epoch when this batch window ended.

sampleRateHz.description: Expected sample rate used by the device during this batch (e.g. 20 for a 50 ms tick interval).

samples.description: Raw linear acceleration samples with gravity removed (user accelerometer, m/s²). No derived magnitude or score.

timestamp.description: Milliseconds since epoch when the sample was captured.

x.description: Linear acceleration along the device X axis (m/s²).

y.description: Linear acceleration along the device Y axis (m/s²).

z.description: Linear acceleration along the device Z axis (m/s²).
